title:
OSL StableHub is expanding.🚀

OSL StableHub will soon support 5 stablecoins — USDGO, USDC, AUSD, RLU
content:
OSL StableHub is expanding.🚀

OSL StableHub will soon support 5 stablecoins — USDGO, USDC, AUSD, RLUSD, and USDG — giving users more flexibility to swap between supported stablecoins with 1:1 zero-fee, no-slippage exchange.

Users can also enjoy attractive APR rewards on selected assets, including up to 8% APR.

More choices for stablecoin swaps.
More ways to manage stablecoin holdings.
